title: Inference Economist: continuous coalescer and safe apply/rollback
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Problem: Customers run a mix of low-latency interactive traffic and high-throughput background jobs. Manually tuning batching and KV caching is error-prone and brittle, leading to either wasted GPU cycles (excess cost) or SLO violations. Goal: Build an "Inference Economist" recommender that continuously profiles workload fingerprints, synthesizes safe batching/coalescing parameters and cache hints, applies them with canaryed rollouts, and supports automated rollback on measurable regressions. Scope: workload fingerprinting, heuristics ruleset, continuous param tuning loop, simulation and dry-run, safe-apply orchestration and automatic rollback policy. Out of scope: UI polishing (console follow-up ticket), persistent storage of historical configs beyond 90 days.
acceptance_criteria: Recommender produces per-route config suggestions (batch_size_target, max_latency_ms_budget, coalescing_window_ms, kv_cache_policy) that pass offline simulation against 7-day traffic samples
Safe-apply pipeline can canary a config to 1% of traffic, escalate to 10% and 50% with automated health checks and rollback triggers
Automated rollback triggers fire when P95 latency increases >=30% over baseline or error rate increases by >=1.5 percentage points for the canary cohort
End-to-end test harness with synthetic replay reproduces cost delta and SLO delta; results stored in the runtime test dashboard
Telemetry emitted for every recommended change: estimated_cost_delta, observed_cost_delta_24h, observed_latency_delta_24h, policy_decision_reason
rollout_plan: Dry-run mode: apply suggestion to simulator and compute estimated cost/SLO delta using 7d historical window
Canary: 1% traffic for 1 hour with strict metric gating
Automatic rollback: immediate rollback if error criteria met; otherwise rollback if sustained negative impact over 24h window
Manual override: SRE can abort rollout from Console with explanation required
testing_plan: Unit tests for heuristics rules and synthetic workloads
Large-scale replay: run recommended configs against anonymized 7-day traffic in staging runtime
Chaos tests: introduce delayed responses and transient errors to ensure rollback triggers behave
Performance test: confirm batcher throughput improves and GPU tail latency does not regress beyond thresholds
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Overaggressive coalescing increases P95 latency for interactive routes. Mitigation: conservative default coalescing_window_ms and stricter gating for routes with median latency < 200ms.

Risk: Incorrect fingerprinting groups heterogeneous workloads together. Mitigation: hierarchical fingerprinting (route-level, client-signature, time-of-day cluster) and fallback to per-route safe defaults.
Risk: Telemetry ingestion lag causes stale decisions. Mitigation: require minimum freshness of 15 minutes for any auto-apply; dry-run reminders in console.

Risk: Rollback flapping during noisy signals. Mitigation: use smoothing window (exponential decay) and only trigger immediate rollback on large, short-term spikes (error + lat increase simultaneously).
